summary: Master the art of event planning with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills to manage and execute memorable events.
lede: Event planning and management brings event objectives, budgets, venues, suppliers, schedules, and risk controls into a coordinated delivery plan. Designed for event coordinators, conference planners, and other professionals supporting business gatherings, the course builds practical skills in drafting event briefs and budgets, comparing venues and suppliers, organizing registration and attendee logistics, and managing live delivery with run sheets and risk registers. It also covers promotion, stakeholder coordination, and post-event evaluation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate events, manage delivery logistics, or support business gatherings and need a structured, practical method for event planning and management training.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic workplace experience in administration, coordination, hospitality, marketing, meetings support, or project delivery. No coding is required. A working knowledge of spreadsheets, document preparation, and general office communication will help you complete the practical exercises more efficiently. The course introduces digital registration tools and AI-assisted planning concepts at a practical level, but it does not require prior technical training.
